snippet.title: Into Space 2 | Become a spaceman! 🚀 #space #endlessrunner #game
snippet.description:
Try to reach Mars in a rocket game Into Space 2!
Google Play 👉 bit.ly/intospace2gp
Online 👉 bit.ly/intospace2well

If you are looking for adventures, want to explore the endless space and believe there are no boundaries that can stop you - this game is what you need. It is time to fulfill your dream! You are the Spaceman now!

A professor is building a brand new rocket and you are invited to test it! How far will you get? Will you reach the moon or maybe even the stars? Let’s find out!

What’s Inside?
🚀 Cosmic arcade game
🚀 A full version of the game for free
🚀 A unique upgrade system
🚀 A timekiller to spend free time
🚀 The most wonderful adventure into the skies

Get ready for the tour into the universe! Use the innovative upgrade system to strengthen your spaceship so that your flight lasts longer and your journey is successful! Avoid obstacles and collect points to spend them in the laboratory right on the cosmic station built by the professor!
